title: Selected N-H analog non-cognate holo docking against PDB 1P2Y
scientific_question: Can the single MOLDISC-005 coverage-selected N-H analog be prepared and docked reproducibly into the frozen 1P2Y holo receptor/known pocket under the existing partially validated non-cognate cross-docking capability boundary?

parent_program.selection_rule: highest nearest AqSolDB similarity among generated candidates with chemistry PASS and nearest AqSolDB Tanimoto >= 0.4

docking.grid_rule: derive from exact crystallographic NCT reference coordinates using research-os.redocking.v1.1 native-ligand box rule

receptor_preparation.removed_hetero_components: all HETATM except HEM; crystallographic waters are not retained

primary_endpoint.name: technical docking completion under frozen non-cognate holo protocol
primary_endpoint.pass_condition: Vina 1.2.7 returns zero, produces at least one parseable pose and preserves receptor/grid/input provenance

interpretation_boundaries: MOLDISC-006 evaluates one preselected generated analog and performs no molecule selection.
A Vina score is E2 computational output and is not measured binding affinity, potency or free energy.
No RMSD to crystallographic NCT is reported because N-H and NCT are different molecular graphs.
The 1P2Y holo known-pocket context is NON_COGNATE_HOLO_CROSSDOCKING and remains only partially validated.
1P2Y is a heme enzyme; the receptor preparation must retain the crystallographic HEM cofactor and its iron atom. A receptor missing HEM is a protocol failure.
A technically completed docking run does not establish correct binding mode, CYP activity, metabolism, efficacy, safety or clinical utility.
Docking parameters, candidate identity and grid derivation may not be changed in response to the first valid observed score.
Protocol v1.0 is preserved as INVALID_PREPARATION because Open Babel produced an empty receptor PDBQT.
Protocol v1.1 is preserved as INDETERMINATE_TARGET_TEMPLATE because Meeko 0.8.0 could not resolve HEM from default/automatic templates and no docking was executed.

Protocol v1.2 changes only HEM template resolution by supplying the official RCSB CCD HEM ideal SDF through Meeko --add_templates; candidate, target, grid, Vina settings and endpoint remain unchanged.

closure.reason: 1P2Y requires HEM. v1.0 produced an empty receptor with Open Babel; v1.1 could not resolve HEM in Meeko defaults; v1.2 supplied the official RCSB HEM CCD ideal SDF but the active RDKit/Meeko template path could not sanitize the metal-containing representation. No valid receptor PDBQT was produced.
closure.decision: Do not introduce manual Fe/HEME atom types, charges, or a new metalloprotein parameterization method inside MOLDISC-006.
closure.next_step: Return to a target whose preparation is already inside the validated non-metal docking capability envelope.
